title: Historic Germantown Carriage House
description:
Welcome to our newly built carriage house in the heart of Historic Germantown, one of Nashville’s most walkable neighborhoods. 

The property is 1 mile north of downtown and guests can easily walk to award-winning restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, cocktail bars, and local boutiques that are just minutes away.

Enjoy a private entrance, free onsite parking, and your own balcony - offering the perfect blend of comfort, quality, and a prime location.

The space
This private one-bedroom guest house features a large bedroom, full bathroom, well-equipped kitchen, in-unit laundry, and a bright living area with vaulted ceilings and modern finishes. Guests also enjoy a private balcony, perfect for morning coffee or relaxing after exploring the city.
